import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "585fbf9340de57a9bc6fcd662e5979bb37a9c7c9"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status = run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in ["src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","src/do_again/browser/paths.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"]:
    p=wt/rel
    if not p.exists(): continue
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    for n,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line for k in [
            "class BrowserPaths", "def browser_paths", "def load_config", "def save_config",
            "def _atomic_json", "def _read_json", "def notify_receipts", "def _rollover_project_chat",
            "def register_project", "def _project_record_path"
        ]):
            start=max(1,n-8); end=min(len(lines),n+35)
            print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
            for i in range(start,end+1):
                print(f"{i:04d}: {lines[i-1]}")
